column2: The loss of a protector or friend
Raised under strict doctrine or ideology
Was mentored by a powerful figure
Committed a terrible act in the past
Was falsely accused of a crime
Discovered a hidden truth about the world
Was forced to flee their homeland
Was part of a failed rebellion or cause
Was idolized by others growing up
Experienced a miraculous or unexplainable event
Self-sacrifice is the only way to be worthy
I must be perfect to be worthy
I am defined by my past
I cannot change who I am
Control is the only way to stay safe
If I lose control everything falls apart
People will leave if they see the real me
My value comes from what I achieve
If I fail once I am a failure
I must always be in control
You are not defined by your past
Imperfection is part of being human
Your value is not tied to achievement
You have the power to choose
The world is not against you
Not everything needs to be controlled
You are enough as you are
You can change who you are
